# MultipleChoice

A vertical list of radio buttons or checkboxes for multiple choice selections. Supports both single selection (radio) and multiple selection (checkbox) modes.

**Import:** `import { MultipleChoice } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/MultipleChoice.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/MultipleChoice.stories.jsx` — Overview, Variants, Content, Sizes, InteractionStates, Interactive
